title: The dreams of a yellow tounliving in the house where there is a tornado, so you run to the other house and everything is yellow.
content: I met someone that was also an empath And I told her about my dream when I was a kid that there was a yellow town and I kept running from house-to-house. Trying to escape the tornado and she said. Yeah, I used to have that dream too. Everything was yellow. Anyone else have that dream of like a yellow dusty town with tornadoes?
